name: Rita Screter
source:
The protagonist's personal secretary. She was originally the secretary of another person, but the protagonist took her in.
She is an excellent person, who sometimes speaks lightly to the protagonist, but does not neglect to follow and care for him.

In reality, however, she has already lost her virginity to the hero and has been hypnotized and brainwashed.
She is a secretary who does everything for the hero, from carrying out his duties to keeping him company at night.
In public, she calls the sub-captain and the hero by his names, but when they are alone, she calls him master.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/23774#product-character]official website[/url]]
